sentence: This project builds a program of courses and research in cybersecurity, transportation security and critical infrastructure security.
This project builds artificial intelligence models that find evasive malware and vulnerabilities in web applications.
This project builds chiral nanoparticles and studies how they move through tissue and enter living cells.
This project uses the fruit fly to find out how neural stem cells divide and build the brain.
This project uses artificial intelligence to build efficient modules of glacier processes that improve how ice-sheet models forecast sea-level rise.
This project runs a summer research program on micro and nano manufacturing and additive manufacturing, also called 3D printing.
This project builds stackable modules that teach artificial intelligence skills within computer technology and advanced manufacturing degree pathways.
This project builds a program that prepares people to protect artificial intelligence systems and to use artificial intelligence to strengthen cybersecurity.
This project builds a tool that sorts patient referrals and matches them to providers using machine learning.
This project runs a neutrino telescope in Antarctic ice that detects neutrinos, subatomic particles with almost no mass, to study extreme phenomena in the Universe.
This project develops mathematical tools to study when waves that travel without changing shape persist, break apart or interact in systems with multiple components.
This project builds robotic sensors that move in small steps using energy harvested from light or radio transmitters instead of batteries.
This project studies how robots and farmworkers can work together to harvest fresh fruit from trees more efficiently and with better working conditions.
This project builds metasurfaces and photonic devices from van der Waals materials that can be tuned with electrical bias.
This project builds a program that prepares people with skills in both cybersecurity and artificial intelligence through project-based learning and research.
This project sets up a Security Operations Center with live feeds from a firewall and other tools, and builds cybersecurity exercises around it.
This project studies how the curved shape of thin shells steers acoustic waves, and how shapes that change form can adjust that steering on demand.
